Resolves #19969

`syncVnodeTree()` now mounts the children it finds on a render, and on an update landing only while its component is mounted: `mountsChildren = me.mounted || !deltas`. The `removeDom` gate `#19967` merged missed a container nested in an unmounted `document.body` root. An ancestor's unmount cascades `mounted: false` but no `removeDom`, so that container's own late landing still marked its children mounted, and the next show skipped their mount hooks. Only two paths reach `syncVnodeTree()`: `onInitVnode()`, a render with `deltas` `null`, and the `executeVdomUpdate()` landing, which always passes an array.

Evidence: L3 (local headless Chromium, `playwright.config.component.mjs`: a browser arm red at the merged `#19967` code and green at head) → L3 required (AC-3).

Replacing `!me.vdom.removeDom` with `!deltas` in `syncVnodeTree` cuts to the actual invariant: `syncVnodeTree` has only two callers (`onInitVnode` via `afterSetVnode` with `deltas = null`, and `executeVdomUpdate` with `response.deltas || []`), so distinguishing initial render from an update landing eliminates any dependency on how an ancestor unmounted the subtree.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: Because `mountsChildren = me.mounted || !deltas` grants child mounting whenever `deltas` is falsy (`null`), I audited every `.vnode =` assignment and `syncVnodeTree` call site across `src/` (`rg -n "\.vnode\s*=" src/` and `rg -n "syncVnodeTree" src/`) to verify whether an unmounted component can ever enter `syncVnodeTree` with `deltas = null` outside a mounting render. The only non-null `.vnode =` write in `src/` is `onInitVnode` (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs:1026`), which runs before `me.mounted = true` (line 1044 when `useVdomWorker` is true, or line 848 after `Neo.applyDeltas` when `useVdomWorker` is false). If a caller explicitly invokes `initVnode(false)` (or configures `autoInitVnode: true, autoMount: false`) on a container to pre-create its vnode without mounting into the DOM, `onInitVnode(vnode, false)` triggers `afterSetVnode` → `syncVnodeTree(vnode, null)` and sets `component.mounted = true` on its children while the container itself remains `mounted: false`. That behavior is pre-existing (both before `#19967` and under `!me.vdom.removeDom`) and non-blocking for `#19969`, as `mountFlight` / `show()` always calls `initVnode(true)`.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: In `Neo.mixin.VdomLifecycle#syncVnodeTree`, `!me.vdom.removeDom` only detects unmounts initiated directly on `me`, because `Container#afterSetMounted(false)` cascades `mounted = false` to descendants without mutating their `vdom.removeDom`. Keying `mountsChildren` on `me.mounted || !deltas` aligns child mounting with the two actual entry paths (`onInitVnode` where `deltas === null`, and `executeVdomUpdate` where `deltas` is always an array).
